OpenRadView opens the DICOM and NIfTI files from your scan CD or zip on your own computer: linked axial, coronal and sagittal views, experimental 3D and measurements. Optional MCP access for your own AI agent. It is a personal research project for education and has not been clinically validated. Ask a qualified clinician to interpret your scans; do not use the app for decisions about care.

Launch tags:Education•Artificial Intelligence•GitHub [...] Point it at the disc, the zip or a folder, and it opens the DICOM or NIfTI files on your computer. You get linked axial, coronal and sagittal views, oblique planes, experimental 3D, and distance and angle measurements. No account, no telemetry, no upload.   
  
It's free, open source, and written in Rust with egui and wgpu, so images render on the GPU: Metal acceleration on Apple Silicon, and it works on Windows and Linux with a dedicated GPU too.

There's no AI inside. If you want, an agent you already use, or a local model, can connect over MCP and ask to see a view. Nothing is shared until you allow it, and the agent's replies can be wrong. [...] Free

Hey Product Hunt (again),

I lost my mother recently. She is the reason I started experimenting with this.  
  
After a CT, MRI or X-ray, a radiologist reads the images and you get a written report. The images often come home too, on a CD or as a zip. Many discs include a viewer, but it usually runs only on Windows, so on a Mac you're left with files you can't open. OpenRadView is for people who want to see their own images anyway.

results.content: OpenAlternative is a curated directory and platform designed to help users discover open source alternatives to proprietary software and applications. The platform serves as a comprehensive resource for individuals and organizations seeking transparent, community-driven options across a wide range of software categories. The platform functions as a searchable database that catalogs open source projects and tools, allowing users to explore alternatives based on their specific needs. Whether seeking replacements for project management software, productivity tools, development platforms, or other applications, OpenAlternative provides structured information to facilitate informed decision-making. The directory includes detailed descriptions of each alternative, highlighting core [...] descriptions of each alternative, highlighting core functionalities and distinguishing characteristics that enable meaningful comparisons. A key strength of OpenAlternative lies in its community-driven approach. The platform aggregates recommendations and maintains a curated list that reflects collective knowledge and user experiences. This model helps ensure that featured alternatives are actively maintained, reliable, and genuinely useful for their intended purposes. The platform emphasizes transparency by showcasing open source solutions that prioritize user control, data privacy, and accessibility. The database covers diverse software categories and use cases, making it relevant for various audiences—from individual users exploring cost-effective alternatives to enterprises evaluating [...] cost-effective alternatives to enterprises evaluating customizable solutions that align with their technical infrastructure. Each listing provides context about the alternative's capabilities, helping users understand whether a particular tool matches their requirements. OpenAlternative appeals particularly to users concerned with software transparency, customization, and avoiding vendor lock-in. By centralizing information about open source options, the platform reduces the friction typically involved in researching and evaluating alternative software solutions. The structured format enables quick comparison and evaluation, supporting both casual exploration and deliberate software selection processes.
